data.text:
Manish Kumar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 22 January, 
2024 
Author: Pranay Verma
Bench: Pranay Verma
 1
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pranay Verma
 On The 22 nd Of January, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 53 of 2024
 Between:-
 Manish Kumar S/O Ramesh Chandra Agrawal,
 Aged About 34 Years, Occupation: Business, R/O:
 Krishna Nagar Neemuch (Madhya Pradesh)
 
 (By Shri Revat Singh Raghuvanshi - Advocate)
 And
 1. The State Of Madhya Pradesh Station
 House Officer Through Police Station
 Baghana District Neemuch (Madhya
 Pradesh)
 2. Food Safety Officer Food And Drug
 Administration, Neemuch (Madhya
 Pradesh)
 
 (BY SHRI NISHA JAISWAL - PANEL LAWYER) 
 This application coming on for admission this day, t  following:
 ORDER Learned counsel for the petitioner prays for withdrawal of this petition. Prayer is allowed and the petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
